title: saussurea riederi subsp. kudoana
intro: Saussurea riederi subsp. kudoana, commonly known as Kudo's saussurea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Saussurea riederi subsp. kudoana include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which may help to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
